title: Open your shop
headline: Open your *shop*
sub: Sign up, tell Taskiem about your business, and be found.

en: Meet Zainab. She runs Zuri Atelier, a tailoring business in Surulere, and today she joins Taskiem.
She types the code Taskiem sends to her WhatsApp.
First, Taskiem asks her to agree to the terms.
This is a business, so she picks A business.
What is the business called? Zuri Atelier.
What does she sell? Fashion, number three.
How do customers pay? Cash and bank transfer.
Done: Zuri Atelier is on Taskiem.
pcm: Meet Zainab. She dey run Zuri Atelier, tailor business for Surulere, and today she dey join Taskiem.
She dey type the code wey Taskiem send to her WhatsApp.
First, Taskiem go ask her make she agree to the terms.
Na business, so she pick A business.
Wetin be the business name? Zuri Atelier.
Wetin she dey sell? Fashion, number three.
How customers dey pay? Cash and bank transfer.
E don do: Zuri Atelier don dey Taskiem.

en: Zainab wants buyers to find her.
She turns on Be found in Explore.
She types her area, so buyers near her find her.
Her card shows her line and her area.
A buyer taps Find a business.
And Zuri Atelier is listed, with Fashion beside it.
pcm: Zainab want make buyers find her.
She turn on Be found for Explore.
She type her area, so buyers wey near fit find her.
Her card show her line and her area.
Buyer go tap Find a business.
And Zuri Atelier dey the list, with Fashion beside am.

bridge.en: Her shop is open, but the shelves are empty. What does she put on them?
bridge.pcm: Shop don open, but shelf dey empty. Wetin she go put for inside?

flow.purpose: cold open: a busy tailor with a buzzing phone
flow.action: Measures a length of indigo-and-gold Ankara across a cutting table with her tape measure while her phone buzzes again and again beside her; she glances at it, laughs softly and shakes her head
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara, two sewing machines, a rack of finished outfits in plastic covers, a window on a yellow-painted wall

flow.purpose: bridge: an empty rack, a pile of fabric
flow.action: Looks at an empty clothes rack, then at a tall stack of folded Ankara fabric on the table, and nods slowly with her hands on her hips
flow.setting: Zuri Atelier workroom, Surulere: a bright room, a cutting table with bolts of Ankara, a nearly empty clothes rack, a window on a yellow-painted wall
flow.camera: medium shot from the side, then a gentle pan to the fabric
